From 9648f1c3739505557d94ff749a4f32192ea81fe3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Vinay Belgaumkar <vinay.belgaumkar@intel.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Feb 2022 10:15:04 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915/guc/slpc: Correct the param count for unset param

SLPC unset param H2G only needs one parameter - the id of the
param.

Fixes: 025cb07bebfa ("drm/i915/guc/slpc: Cache platform frequency limits")

Suggested-by: Umesh Nerlige Ramappa <umesh.nerlige.ramappa@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Vinay Belgaumkar <vinay.belgaumkar@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Umesh Nerlige Ramappa <umesh.nerlige.ramappa@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Ramalingam C <ramalingam.c@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20220216181504.7155-1-vinay.belgaumkar@intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c
index 13b27b8ff74e..ba21ace973da 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c
@@ -110,7 +110,7 @@ static int guc_action_slpc_unset_param(struct intel_guc *guc, u8 id)
 {
 	u32 request[] = {
 		GUC_ACTION_HOST2GUC_PC_SLPC_REQUEST,
-		SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 2),
+		SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 1),
 		id,
 	};
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c`**
   - The function `guc_action_slpc_unset_param` was modified to change the second argument of the `SLPC_EVENT` macro from `2` to `1`. This change reflects that the SLPC unset parameter H2G only requires one parameter, which is the ID of the parameter being unset.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `intel_guc_slpc.c` corrects the parameter count for the SLPC unset parameter action, addressing a bug introduced in a previous commit (identified by the hash `025cb07bebfa`). This change ensures that the function correctly aligns with the intended functionality of only needing the parameter ID, thereby fixing the issue related to parameter handling in the SLPC context.

Here is the commit message:
drm/i915/guc/slpc: Correct the param count for unset param

SLPC unset param H2G only needs one parameter - the id of the
param.

Fixes: 025cb07bebfa ("drm/i915/guc/slpc: Cache platform frequency limits")

Suggested-by: Umesh Nerlige Ramappa <umesh.nerlige.ramappa@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Vinay Belgaumkar <vinay.belgaumkar@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Umesh Nerlige Ramappa <umesh.nerlige.ramappa@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Ramalingam C <ramalingam.c@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20220216181504.7155-1-vinay.belgaumkar@intel.com

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by incorrectly specifying the number of parameters required for the SLPC unset parameter action in the `guc_action_slpc_unset_param` function. The code originally indicated that two parameters were needed, while only one (the ID of the parameter) was actually required, leading to potential miscommunication with the SLPC subsystem and incorrect handling of parameter unset requests.

Here is the patch:
 
 static int guc_action_slpc_unset_param(struct intel_guc *guc, u8 id)
 {
 	u32 request[] = {
 		GUC_ACTION_HOST2GUC_PC_SLPC_REQUEST,
-		SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 2),
+		SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 1),
 		id,
 	};
 
 	return intel_guc_send(guc, request, ARRAY_SIZE(request));
 }

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 2),
```
Reason:
The function `guc_action_slpc_unset_param` incorrectly specifies that two parameters are needed for the SLPC unset parameter action when only one (the ID of the parameter) is required. This mismatch can lead to miscommunication with the SLPC subsystem, causing it to expect more parameters than it should, potentially resulting in incorrect handling of parameter unset requests.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 1),
```
Reason:
The patch corrects the number of parameters specified for the SLPC unset parameter action from 2 to 1, aligning it with the actual requirement. This change ensures that the SLPC subsystem receives the correct number of parameters, allowing for proper handling of the parameter unset requests.
